No new switch, door, or goal was found along this specific corridor -- it dead-ends at the wall. (2) THE THREE E-TILE DOORS FOUND IN ROUND 13's DEATH-OVERVIEW ARE NOW CONFIRMED REACHABLE AND OPENABLE IN LIVE PLAY: from the fall-through landing spot, all three doors (previously only glimpsed) were clicked in sequence and opened cleanly (63->42->21->0 color-14 cells, one door per click, no death) -- but opening them replaced their cells with plain wall texture rather than revealing an obvious new passage in the immediate camera view, matching the general_gotchas warning that door-open semantics/outcomes are inconsistent and not fully understood. No new level banked; frontier stays at level 8. Given the level's escalating complexity (confirmed: a matched switch pair, a hazard-zone floor, a pillar-growth mechanic, a fall-through shaft, a full corridor of growable pillars, three openable doors, and now a door-triggered new death), this session is pausing bp35 L9 exploration here after five consecutive rounds of genuine, verified progress without a win, in favor of giving first-contact attention to the two other unsolved public games (lf52, sk48) per operator direction.
